label: Mixes up open and closed interval endpoints
reteach: Use a number line and mark included endpoints with a filled dot and excluded endpoints with an open dot.

label: Ignores the stated domain in set-builder notation
reteach: Check both parts of a set-builder rule: the domain and the condition.

label: Writes a set-builder rule that does not describe every element
reteach: Test the proposed rule against every listed member and one non-member.

label: Omits a valid negative solution
reteach: Substitute both positive and negative candidates before listing the solution set.

label: Confuses an empty set with a one-element set
reteach: List the elements that satisfy the condition; count them only after testing the rule.

label: Confuses a bounded interval with a finite set of real numbers
reteach: Ask whether the set has finitely many elements, not whether its endpoints are bounded.

label: Treats disjoint sets as sets with similar-looking labels rather than membership
reteach: Compare the actual members and test whether the intersection is empty.

label: Counts overlap twice when finding a union
reteach: Add each set size, then subtract the intersection once.

label: Reverses the direction of set difference
reteach: Read A minus B as: start with A and remove anything that is also in B.

label: Confuses union with intersection
reteach: Union means in at least one set; intersection means in both sets.

label: Loses a negative sign during algebraic manipulation
reteach: Write one transformation per line and re-check signs when moving terms.

label: Uses an operation on one side of an equation only
reteach: Keep an equation balanced by applying the same operation to both sides.

label: Adds fractions without a common denominator
reteach: Convert to a common denominator before adding numerators.

label: Substitutes a value into the wrong variable
reteach: Circle the target variable and replace only that variable with the supplied value.

label: Applies an inconsistent row operation
reteach: Write the chosen row operation explicitly and apply it to every entry in that row.

label: Uses the wrong sign in determinant expansion
reteach: Mark the alternating cofactor signs before multiplying each minor.

label: Mixes quantities with incompatible dimensions
reteach: Write units beside each quantity and confirm both sides have the same dimensions.

label: Chooses a formula without checking its conditions
reteach: List what is known, what is asked, and the conditions each candidate formula requires.

label: Misses a key word, constraint, or requested output
reteach: Underline the command word, constraints, and final quantity before solving.

label: Shows a procedure but omits the reasoning needed to justify it
reteach: Add a short reason to each important step and state why the result follows.

label: Makes an isolated arithmetic slip after choosing a suitable method
reteach: Estimate the expected size/sign first, then recompute the arithmetic independently.

label: Other or uncertain pattern - teacher review needed
reteach: Review the original working with the student before selecting a targeted explanation.
